text:
maya: quick sync — GCP sent a revised EDP proposal, want input on sizing and guarantees before replying.
jonathan: TL;DR numbers?
maya: 24m term, $3.6M/yr committed, 25% off listed GPU rates. regional pool (us-west1, eu-west4) with "best-effort" burst above committed capacity.
kelly: infra baseline: ~90 A100-eq steady, peaks ~220 for training. region split 65% us-west1 / 25% eu-west4 / 10% ap-southeast.
arjun: could we mix reservations? fewer big GPU reservations + more vCPU/RAM reserved for infer to lower $/token.
priya_finance: payment terms? up-front vs quarterly true-up? cashflow matters.
gcp-sales: draft terms: quarterly true-up, monthly billing against committed, 60-day payment. up-front prepay optional for extra discount.
jonathan: what's the delta if we prepay?
gcp-sales: prepay 24m = extra 5% on top of 25% -> ~30% effective. can offer soft 90% capacity guarantee for committed pool; burst above is best-effort.
kelly: 90% in us-west1 not acceptable for training peaks. need 95% or dedicated hosts for critical windows.
maya: ops risk: cross-region fallback adds latency and dev lift. ask for 95% us-west1 committed SLA + migration credits if they miss it.
arjun: negotiate a +/-20% true-up buffer monthly and a one-time seasonal spike allowance.
priya_finance: legal/finance asks: termination notice 60 days, audit rights, explicit service credit mechanism for missed capacity.
gcp-sales: service credits are doable. 95% guarantee requires either moving some capacity to dedicated hosts or increasing committed spend.
jonathan: run scenarios: A) keep $3.6M/yr @25%, 90% guarantee. B) $3.9M/yr prepay -> ~30% off + 95% SLA. C) $2.8M/yr smaller commit focused on us-west1 with cross-region fallback. model cost vs risk.
kelly: eng preference B if finance OK. propose dedicated hosts for 10-20% of pool during training windows.
priya_finance: I'll model cashflow & P&L for A/B/C by Thu. need contract breakage terms and CAPEX treatment for prepay.
maya: proposed negotiation asks to GCP:
- 24m EDP with option to scale committed GPUs +/-20% annually
- 30% effective discount if we prepay quarterly (32% if full prepay)
- 95% regional capacity guarantee for us-west1 with service credits and migration credits
- monthly true-up floor +/-20% and one-time seasonal buffer
- credits applied to next invoice for missed capacity
- 60-day termination notice + audit rights
jonathan: also propose escape clause if public on-demand prices drop >15% to re-open pricing.
arjun: allow conversion of committed spend to other GCP SKUs (host reservations, local SSD, networking) for flexibility.
kelly: include runbook handoff and quarterly capacity review + 30-day emergency burst window process.
gcp-sales: I'll push these into a term sheet and get back with three scenarios + SLA language by EOD Friday.
maya: action items: priya_finance model scenarios, kelly map training windows & dedicated needs, jonathan/arjun prepare fallback clauses. penciling Fri 10am PT to review term sheet. tagging: @priya_finance @kelly @jonathan @arjun :thumbsup:
